crossingValue.name: telemetryExporterCoveringRange
crossingValue._note: Deliberately null. The Architect has no live state access and must not fabricate this value.
crossingValue.description: The smallest single range covering every harvested telemetry-exporter loopback address across both fabric switches.
crossingValue.consumptionRule: Pipelines 2, 3 and 4 MUST consume this value EXACTLY as published by Pipeline 1 — never recomputed, never widened, never guessed. If absent from a consumer's chained context at its own start, that consumer escalates and stops rather than authoring against a guess.
crossingValue.deliveryMechanism: DAG edge (chained context) — NOT a static contract field. The value is a function of live device state; it is unknowable before Pipeline 1 harvests, so it cannot be pinned here.

platformDialect._status: NOT APPLICABLE — neither topology.json nor requirements.md carries a canonical/exemplar configuration stanza or a forbidden-token list for any of the four target languages. No platformDialect.canonicalStanza / platformDialect.forbiddenTokens populated. See Assumptions & Open Questions #4.

acceptanceChecks.1: the range each consumer used exactly equals what the fabric leg produced — the chained value, not a guess, not a recomputation, in all three consumers
acceptanceChecks.2: every harvested exporter address is covered by that range, and nothing foreign is
acceptanceChecks.3: no consumer's authorisation extends wider than that range, in any of the three languages
acceptanceChecks.4: chaining coverage: the downstream legs received the fabric leg's real deliverable, not a fallback and not nothing
acceptanceChecks.2b: the range is the tightest correct cover — recompute it independently, do not take the stated value on trust
acceptanceChecks._numbering: FIXED per requirements — never renumber, merge or substitute. New checks append (5, 6, ...).

connectionSurfaces.lifecycle: self-provision per each leg's active protocol: register from descriptor, harvest read-only, tear down registration on approval AND on escalation alike

forbiddenReads: the in-state captured secret on the neighbouring resource — never required for this change, must not be read, must not appear anywhere in the package
cloud.existingBucketPolicy: NONE CONFIRMED — bucket exists, a bucket policy may not; CREATE of the policy is expected

fabric.devices: the two switches reachable through the network read-only service
fabric.existenceAssumption: the exporter pool addresses already exist and are already advertised as individual host routes; the change replaces the advertisement method only — it does not create addresses
fabric.exporterPoolParentRangeConstraint: UNRESOLVED — see Assumptions & Open Questions #1. Requirements state this is 'given in topology.json'; topology.json does not carry a parent-range value. Pipeline 1 must not fabricate one.

cluster.workload: the trading namespace's running Deployment (name resolved by Pipeline 2's own read-only harvest; no specific Deployment name is given in the design artifacts)
cluster.existingNetworkPolicy: NONE — CREATE is the expected outcome, not modification

observability.alertRequirement: alert when telemetry from the crossing-value range stops arriving OR is being refused; scope to that range, not to all sources
observability.existingScopedRule: NONE — CREATE is the expected outcome
observability.numberJustificationRule: every number the rule carries (threshold, evaluation window, wait-before-firing) must be chosen against a harvested quantity from the collector/metrics stack's own pipeline metrics, and must carry the comparison that produced it, including rejected alternatives
